run_benchmark_diff_pipeline: run the full microbenchmark diff pipeline comparing new and old builds with PR comments
build_benchmarks_for_commit: build benchmark binaries for a given commit by checking out a diff base and running bm_build
create_benchmark_jobs: create benchmark run jobs for new and old builds with configurable loops and regex filters
diff_benchmark_results: diff benchmark results between old and new runs and post performance notes to a PR
retry_on_eintr: wrap a function to automatically retry on EINTR errors until it completes successfully
